description: This is a test class for the TerminationReasonConfigurationService within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It contains unit tests for methods such as retrieving lists of termination reasons, getting a termination reason by ID, deleting reasons, and fetching by name. The class employs mock objects to isolate the service's behavior and uses test data fixtures.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit-style PHPUnit test case for testing the TerminationReasonConfigurationService methods, including list retrieval, fetching by ID or name, and deletion of termination reasons.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating an instance of the service and loading test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the list of termination reasons with mocked DAO returning test data.

methods.name: testGetTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Tests fetching a termination reason by its ID with mocked DAO.

methods.name: testDeleteTerminationReasons
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple termination reasons using mocked DAO.

methods.name: testGetTerminationReasonByName
methods.description: Tests fetching a termination reason by its name with mocked DAO.
